items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: Sousa marches around the town and on the football field.

ctx.x: But what was the next instrument after the piano?

It was the trumpet. And that was in high school. Well what do you have four years in high school? The fourth year I bought a trumpet or a cornet and got into the band. I’d been in the choir for four years, so I had ear training and I could read music, and I knew where I was supposed to be in the choir and all that, but playing the trumpet in the band was a lot of fun, especially marching. I loved marching in a band on the street — Sousa marches around the town and on the football field. That was a lot of fun. And…
